title: CRT Ring Isomorphism Z/mnZ = Z/mZ x Z/nZ

problemStatement.plain: Can the Chinese Remainder Theorem ring isomorphism be formalized in Lean 4 building on `crt_via_bezout`? This is the algebraic formulation: the map sending x mod mn to (x mod m, x mod n) is a ring isomorphism when gcd(m,n) = 1.
